15 / Platforms & web

Arsa Creative — A creative agency and portfolio web platform

A showcase that presents creative work at the highest visual quality.

Year
2026
Scope
Platforms & web
  • SSR
    instant loading and SEO
  • Lazy
    heavy media without straining the server
  • 100%
    responsive across every device

01 / Overview

The Arsa Creative website serves as the agency’s digital business card. It was designed with attention to visual detail and minimalist UX, with the goal of showing the portfolio attractively and making it easy for prospective clients to get in touch.

02 / The problem

The agency presents its work through heavy, high-quality images and video. Loading them as they were slowed the site down, and visitors left within the first five seconds.

03 / Our approach

Media is optimised with Next.js built-in tools — Image Optimization and lazy loading — so it loads without straining the server. The interface is split into modular React components and combined with SSR, so animations run smoothly and the page appears immediately.

04 / The result

The portfolio gallery opens without interruption, the site is indexed correctly by Google, and visitor enquiries arrive securely through a .NET Core API.

05 / Key features

What it does.

  • 01

    Dynamic portfolio gallery

    Completed work in high-quality image and video formats, without interruption.

  • 02

    Interactive animations that reflect the brand’s creative character.

  • 03

    Speed and SEO

    Near-instant loading and strong search ranking through Next.js SSR.

  • 04

    Secure contact forms

    Enquiries go through the .NET Core API to the database or by email.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. Media optimisation

    Heavy files load through Next.js Image Optimization and lazy loading without overloading the server.

  2. Component-based interface

    A modular React approach gives a clean codebase and fully responsive behaviour on every device.
